run_preprocess: run the preprocess method to smooth node features and labels on a graph using SGC, SIGN, or APPNP
smooth_signals_fullg: smooth node features or labels across the full graph with configurable normalization and reduction orders
smooth_signals_subg: smooth signals on a subgraph with symmetric, random-walk, or PPR normalization
prepare_raw_label: prepare one-hot encoded label features from training or validation node sets
f_decode_smoothen_config: parse a hyphen-separated configuration string to extract normalization type, order, and reduction settings
